user.title: Water Softener Salt Tracker Configuration
user.description: Configure tracking parameters based on your water meter and softener specifications.

meter_below_baseline.title: Water meter reading is below the salt tracker baseline
meter_below_baseline.description:
The water meter `{entity_id}` used by **{name}** reads {reading}, which is lower than the reading of {baseline} stored at the last salt refill. The meter has probably been reset or replaced, so salt usage cannot be tracked correctly.

Press the **Reset Salt Level** button to start tracking again from the current meter reading.
